before: A decision of several suggestions planned all their items as one batch and refused the card when the batch left any of them, so a card the editor alone decides item by item (a deletion over a paragraph mark whose paragraph holds the author's paragraph record) was refused as engine-refused (incomplete-group).
after: The plan still selects every item of the cards, but a card stays only when it leaves an item the editor decides with its dependencies (decidedAsBatch); an item the editor resolves on its own sites is decided as the editor decides it.
reason: Change messages, the change log and its kinds keep their meaning, and the Yjs document format and the checkpoint format do not change. Only the verdict of such a decision changes, from refused to decided, as the editor alone decides it. An ordered room admits only clients of its own code version.
